# Following links

A fixture for following a link to another Markdown file in the pager. Tab
selects a link, Enter follows it and Backspace comes back to this place.

![The icon of the start document](../images/icon.png)

## The links

A link to [the second heading of the other document](docs/other.md#second)
opens `docs/other.md` over this one, with that heading on the top line, and
the status line names the file.

A link to [a file that is not there](docs/missing.md) says why it cannot be
opened and opens nothing.
